art.label: Type
art.hint: Sets the look and which gaps the marking dialog offers.

text.label: Text
text.hint: Text with markers in double curly braces.

audio.label: Audio
audio.hint: An mp3 or ogg file, optional.

gmNotiz.label: GM Note
gmNotiz.hint: Never shown to players. Encrypted in Secret Mode; otherwise readable through the developer console.

preis.label: Cost on Success with Fear
preis.hint: Only you see it when a player decrypts with Success with Fear. Empty = default per type (Anthanen: the Motherboard is listening · Signal: the transmitter traces back · Module: PHI logs the access).

hinweis.label: Hint on Failure with Hope
hinweis.hint: The roller gets this instead of more text: what they would need to read more – e.g. a Netzpfeiler terminal or someone who reads Cordex.

trait.label: Trait
trait.hint: The trait used to decrypt. Default: Knowledge for Anthanen, Instinct for Signal, Finesse for Module.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.hint: The module checks the roll against this Difficulty itself.

rauschen.label: Noise Bed
rauschen.hint: Quiet noise under the audio. 0 = off. Each player can turn it up or down for themselves in the view.

Bearbeiten.Syntax: Syntax: {{gap | reader: text >> replacement}} – readers: Clank (ancestry), @Name (character), Success with Hope (read level). {{cutoff}} cuts off everything after it.

Stufe.Label: Result
Stufe.ZeigenHinweis: Passages with a read level become readable for everyone from this result on.
Stufe.Vorschlag: Suggested from the last Duality roll ({wer}, {total}): {stufe}.
Stufe.OhneDifficulty: The roll had no Difficulty – please choose Success or Failure yourself.
Stufe.KeinWurf: No Duality roll found in the chat.
Stufe.AnAlle: Then show it to all players
Stufe.TotalHinweis: Passages with a DC open for everyone up to this total. Empty: on a success, the page Difficulty counts.

Markieren.ErsatzHinweis: Only for crosstalk, overwritten, locked and infested: whoever can't read it sees this instead of the original.
Markieren.WerLiest: Who can read it? One rule is enough.
Markieren.StufeHinweis: Becomes readable for everyone when you show this result or a better one.
Markieren.ZerfallenHinweis: A “decayed” gap is missing for everyone.
Markieren.KeinEditor: The editor isn't ready yet. Click into the text once and try again.
Markieren.NichtLeer: Select some text first. Only “cutoff” and “decayed” work without it.
Markieren.EinAbsatz: A marker has to stay within one paragraph.
Markieren.DCHinweis: Opens the passage for whoever decrypts with at least this total. Empty: locked, redacted, static and crosstalk use the page Difficulty; other gaps don't open by rolling.
Markieren.KarteHinweis: Opens the passage for anyone carrying a card of at least this level, without a roll. With an issuer, only that issuer's cards count.

Ansicht.Abgerissen: cutoff – everything after this is missing

Warnung.UnbekannteArt: Unknown gap “{art}” – players see a dark gap here.
Warnung.UeberAbsatz: Spans several paragraphs – better to mark each paragraph on its own.
Warnung.UnbekannteAncestry: No character with the ancestry “{name}” found.
Warnung.ZerfallenOhneLeser: “decayed” is missing for everyone – the readers are ignored.

Leser.Hinweis: Who reads like Clank? The module detects it from the ancestry. “Yes” or “No” sets it by hand.
Leser.Keine: No player characters in this world.

Bewegung.Name: Motion
Bewegung.Hint: Flicker and other animations in data carriers. “System” follows your operating system's “reduce motion” setting.

Fenster.Name: Journal Window
Fenster.Hint: How the journal window looks while it shows a data carrier.

KartenGroesse.Name: Size on the Map
KartenGroesse.Hint: How big a data carrier appears when you drag it onto a scene, as a share of one grid square. Applies to newly placed ones.

Item.Name: Folder for Created Items
Item.Hint: Loot items from the Loot button and new access cards land here.

JournalEntry.Name: Folder for Created Journals
JournalEntry.Hint: The Findings journal lands here when the module creates it. You can still move it anywhere later.

Audio.KeineDatei: This page has no audio file.

Geheim.Name: Secret Mode
Geheim.Label: Set Up Secret Mode
Geheim.Hint: Text, GM note, cost and hint are stored only in encrypted form. Players receive from the GM only what they may see (the GM has to be online).
Geheim.Erklaerung: Foundry sends every player all journals – hidden ones included. In Secret Mode, texts are therefore stored only in encrypted form. The key comes from your passphrase; it stays in your browser and never reaches the server. Players ask your client and receive only their own view.
Geheim.WortHinweis: At least 8 characters. Write it down – without the passphrase, encrypted pages can't be opened again. Afterwards all data carriers are encrypted.
Geheim.EinrichtenKnopf: Set Up and Encrypt All Pages
Geheim.Entsperren: Enter the passphrase on this device
Geheim.EntsperrenHinweis: Secret Mode is on, but this browser doesn't know the passphrase yet.
Geheim.AusschaltenFrage: All data carriers will be decrypted and stored as plain text in the world again.
Geheim.ZuKurz: The passphrase needs at least 8 characters.
Geheim.WortFalsch: Motherboard: Data Carrier Journal – the passphrase doesn't match.
Geheim.Eingerichtet: Secret Mode set up – {n} page(s) encrypted.
Geheim.KeinKrypto: This browser offers no encryption (WebCrypto). Foundry has to run over https.
Geheim.KeinSchluessel: This data carrier is encrypted, and this browser doesn't know the passphrase.
Geheim.NurGM: Only the GM can open this data carrier.
Geheim.FehltHinweis: Configure Settings → Motherboard: Data Carrier Journal → Secret Mode. Until then the text stays locked so nothing gets overwritten.
Geheim.BeimSpeichern: Secret Mode on: text, cost, hint and GM note are encrypted when you save.
Geheim.SeiteOffen: Not encrypted – readable through the developer console

Anfrage.KeinGM: The data carrier is silent – the GM is not online.
Anfrage.GmOhneSchluessel: The data carrier is silent – the GM has to enter the passphrase first.
Anfrage.KeineSeite: This page is not a data carrier.
Anfrage.NurGM: Only the GM can answer this.

Entschluesseln.Erklaerung: A player can decrypt each data carrier once. They roll with their character; the module checks the roll and records the result. At first only they see it – they decide whether to share it with everyone.
Entschluesseln.SchonVersucht: This data carrier has already been decrypted.
Entschluesseln.WurfAlt: The roll is too old – please decrypt again.
Entschluesseln.WurfVerbraucht: This roll has already been used.
Entschluesseln.ZuruecksetzenFrage: Result, decryption attempt and all damage are removed – the data carrier is as good as new.

Preis.anthanen: The Motherboard is listening. Something answers – maybe not now, but it knows who read.
Preis.signal: The transmitter traces back. Whoever is sending now knows where you are.
Preis.modul: PHI logs the access. The reader's ID has been reported.

Ergebnis.preis: Decrypted: {stufe}. The access did not go unnoticed.
Ergebnis.zerfallen: {stufe}: A piece of the carrier has decayed.

Kaputt.anthanen: The pulse breaks. Blue light devours the lines.
Kaputt.modul: DATA CARRIER DAMAGED · UNABLE TO READ

Funde.Name: Findings
Funde.Fehler: The “Findings” journal couldn't be updated (details in the console).

Beute.Tip: Create a loot item that points to this data carrier
Beute.Fehlt: The data carrier for this item no longer exists.
Beute.OhneGeheimmodus: Without Secret Mode, a player can read the full text through the developer console.

Beschreibung.anthanen: A flat, round disc of dark metal. No dust settles on it.
Beschreibung.signal: A recording from the buffer of a relay mast.
Beschreibung.modul: A grey chip, barely bigger than a finger joint, with bare contacts along one edge.

Karte.HingelegtVersteckt: “{name}” lies hidden on the map. Right-click the icon, then the eye – and players can find it.
Karte.KeinToken: You need your own token on this map for that.
Karte.ZuWeit: Too far away – get closer (Very Close).

Umzug.Fertig: Motherboard: Data Carrier Journal – took over {seiten} page(s) and {haekchen} checkmark(s) from the old “datentraeger” module.
Umzug.Fehler: Motherboard: Data Carrier Journal – migration failed in: {journale}. Details in the console (F12).

VonHand.Tip: For dice rolled at the table: enter the decryption result by hand
VonHand.Hinweis: For dice rolled at the table. The module treats it like a decryption rolled in Foundry – with the same consequences, and only this character sees the result until their player shares it.
VonHand.AusgangHinweis: Which die rolled higher. Success or Failure follows from the total and the Difficulty.
VonHand.SchonVersucht: This data carrier already has a decryption attempt – reset it first.

Freischalten.NichtDein: Your character doesn't carry this data carrier.

Karten.Tip: Create an access card (Level 1–3) that opens locked passages without a roll
Karten.AusstellerHinweis: Optional, e.g. CTC. A card with an issuer opens “CTC Level 2” and plain “Level 2”; a card without one opens only plain “Level n”.
Karten.Name: Access Card – Level {level}
Karten.BeschreibungMit: An access card issued by {aussteller}, Level {level}.
